knowledge.name: Present simple and present continuous
knowledge.explanation: 习惯动作用一般现在时，此刻进行用 be 加动词-ing，Look、now 是进行时的时间标志。

knowledge.name: Verb-ing spelling rules
knowledge.explanation: 一般加-ing；不发音 e 结尾去 e；重读闭音节双写末字母；ie 结尾改 y 加-ing。

knowledge.name: try to do vs try doing
knowledge.explanation: try doing 表示试试看某做法，try to do 表示努力去做成，两者含义不同。

knowledge.name: Writing a diary entry
knowledge.explanation: 日记记录已发生的事，常用一般过去时，并写出当时的感受。

knowledge.name: Adjectives and adverbs of manner
knowledge.explanation: 形容词修饰名词，副词修饰动词，多数副词由形容词加-ly 构成。

knowledge.name: Comparatives with -er and than
knowledge.explanation: 两者比较用比较级，单音节词加-er，后接 than；good 的比较级是 better。

knowledge.name: Must, should and obligation
knowledge.explanation: must、should 表必须或应该，后接动词原形，用来给出建议或要求。

knowledge.name: Because and when clauses
knowledge.explanation: because 接完整从句表原因，when 引导时间从句，although 表让步。

knowledge.name: Job nouns and suffixes
knowledge.explanation: 动词加-er、-or、-ist 可构成职业名词，如 teacher、actor、scientist。

knowledge.name: Third-person singular -s
knowledge.explanation: 主语为第三人称单数、谈习惯工作时，动词加-s 或-es。

knowledge.name: Wh- questions about work
knowledge.explanation: Where 问地点，Who 问人，What do you do 问职业，疑问词后接一般疑问句语序。

knowledge.name: Object clauses with that
knowledge.explanation: 陈述句作宾语时可用 that 引导宾语从句，从句须含主语和谓语。

knowledge.name: Future with will and there will be
knowledge.explanation: will 加动词原形表将来，There will be 表示将来会有某物。

knowledge.name: Present passive: be + done
knowledge.explanation: 一般现在时被动用 am/is/are 加过去分词，强调动作承受者。

knowledge.name: Prepositions of place
knowledge.explanation: next to 表相邻，above 表在上方，between 用于两者之间。

knowledge.name: Imperatives in a user guide
knowledge.explanation: 说明书用动词原形开头的祈使句给指令，否定形式用 Don't 加原形。

knowledge.name: Past simple: regular and irregular
knowledge.explanation: 过去时间用过去式，规则动词加-ed，see、go、buy 等为不规则变化。

knowledge.name: Superlatives with the -est
knowledge.explanation: 三者以上比较用 the 加最高级，单音节词加-est，good 的最高级是 best。

knowledge.name: Relative clauses with who/that
knowledge.explanation: 先行词是人用 who，是物用 that 或 which 引导定语从句。

knowledge.name: Writing a film review
knowledge.explanation: 影评表达观点，可概述情节，并用过去时评价看过的影片。

knowledge.name: Comparing with -er than
knowledge.explanation: 比较两处地貌用比较级加 than，如 higher、longer、deeper。

knowledge.name: Passive in geography facts
knowledge.explanation: 描述地貌成因常用被动语态，如 is covered、are formed。

knowledge.name: Direction and place words
knowledge.explanation: through 表穿过，in the north 表方位，toward 表方向。

knowledge.name: Describing a landscape
knowledge.explanation: 写景用 steep、clear、peaceful 等形容词，名词加-ful 可构成形容词。
